words.example: Onyx is the technical name for the natural nail.
words.exampleTranslation: onyx（甲）是天然指甲的专业名称。

evidence.quote: The natural nail itself is technically referred to as the onyx

words.example: The nail plate is made mainly of keratin, a protein.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲板主要由角蛋白构成，角蛋白是一种蛋白质。

evidence.quote: is composed mainly of keratin, the fiber-shaped protein found in skin and hair

words.example: The matrix is where new nail plate cells are made.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲母质是生成新甲板细胞的地方。

evidence.quote: The matrix (MAY-triks) is the area where the nail plate cells are formed

words.example: The lunula is the whitish half-moon at the nail base.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲半月是指甲根部发白的半月形。

evidence.quote: It is the whitish, half-moon shape underneath the base of the nail plate.

words.example: The cuticle is dead, colorless tissue stuck to the nail plate.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲小皮是粘在甲板上、无色的死组织。

evidence.quote: The cuticle (KYOO-tih-kul) is the nonliving, colorless tissue attached to the nail plate
The cuticle is dead skin on the nail plate

words.example: The eponychium is living skin that makes the cuticle.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲上皮是生成甲小皮的活皮肤。

evidence.quote: the eponychium is the underside of the proximal nail fold and is the living tissue that makes the cuticle

words.example: The hyponychium is skin between the fingertip and the free edge.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲下皮是指尖和游离缘之间的皮肤。

evidence.quote: The hyponychium (hy-poh-NIK-ee-um) is the slightly thickened layer of skin that lies between the fingertip and the free edge of the nail plate.

words.example: The free edge is the part of the nail over the fingertip.
words.exampleTranslation: 游离缘是指甲伸到指尖上方的那一部分。

evidence.quote: The free edge (FREE EDJ) is the part of the nail plate that extends over the tip of the finger or toe.

words.example: The nail bed is the living skin under the nail plate.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲床是甲板下面的活皮肤。

evidence.quote: The nail bed (NAYL BED) is the portion of living skin that supports the nail plate
the area under the nail plate can have a pinkish appearance

words.example: The bed epithelium attaches the nail plate to the nail bed.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲床上皮把甲板连接在甲床上。

evidence.quote: is attached to the nail plate by a thin layer of tissue called the bed epithelium

words.example: The lateral nail fold, or sidewall, is skin along the nail's side.
words.exampleTranslation: 侧甲襞也叫 sidewall（侧壁），是指甲侧面的皮肤褶。

evidence.quote: also known as the sidewall, (SYD-wall) is the fold of skin overlapping the side of the nail

words.example: The proximal nail fold is living skin, so never cut it.
words.exampleTranslation: 近端甲襞是活皮肤，所以绝不能剪。

evidence.quote: Even if this skin appears dry and hardened, it is part of the living PNF.
are prohibited from cutting or trimming any living tissue, which includes the PNF

words.example: Beau's lines are dents that run across the width of the nail.
words.exampleTranslation: 博氏线是横贯指甲宽度的凹陷。

evidence.quote: Depressions running across the width of the nail plate due to a slowing production of matrix cells

words.example: Onychia means the matrix is inflamed and the nail can fall off.
words.exampleTranslation: onychia（甲母质炎）是指甲母质发炎，指甲可能脱落。

evidence.quote: is an inflammation of the matrix and shedding of the nail caused by inflection or injury

words.example: Leukonychia is white nail spots, usually from small matrix injuries.
words.exampleTranslation: 白甲是指甲上的白斑，通常由甲母质的轻微损伤引起。

evidence.quote: Whitish spots of discoloration of the nails; usually caused by minor injury to the nail matrix.

words.example: Melanonychia can be a dark band from nail base to free edge.
words.exampleTranslation: 黑甲可能表现为从指甲根部到游离缘的一条深色带。

evidence.quote: Significant darkening of the fingernails or toenails caused by increased pigment cells (melanocytes).
Visible as either a black band extending from the base to the free edge

words.example: Never push back nail pterygium; it is abnormally stretched skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 绝不能推甲胬肉，它是异常拉伸的皮肤。

evidence.quote: Abnormal stretching of the eponychium or hyponychium around the nail plate
never attempt to treat or push back nail pterygium with any instrument

words.example: Onychorrhexis means split or brittle nails with a rough surface.
words.exampleTranslation: 脆甲是指甲裂开或易碎，表面粗糙。

evidence.quote: Abnormal split or brittle nails appearing as surface roughness on the nail plate.

words.example: Splinter hemorrhages come from damaged capillaries, not real splinters.
words.exampleTranslation: 裂片形出血来自受损的毛细血管，不是真的木刺。

evidence.quote: Damage to the capillaries under the nail; gives the appearance of a lengthwise small splinter underneath the nail plate.

words.example: Onycholysis is when the nail plate separates from the nail bed.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲剥离是指甲板与甲床分开。

evidence.quote: Separation of the nail plate and bed, often due to injury or allergic reactions.

words.example: Onychocryptosis means ingrown nails that grow into the skin at the sides.
words.exampleTranslation: 嵌甲是指甲从侧边长进皮肉里。

evidence.quote: Ingrown nails on either hands or feet, wherein the nail grows into the sides of the tissue around the nail.

words.example: Onychomycosis is a fungal infection of the nail plate.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲真菌病是甲板的真菌感染。

evidence.quote: Fungal infection of the nail plate.

words.example: Paronychia is a bacterial inflammation around the nail, with pus.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲沟炎是指甲周围的细菌性发炎，会有脓。

evidence.quote: Bacterial inflammation of the tissues around the nail plate, causing pus, swelling, and redness.

words.example: Nail psoriasis can cause tiny pits and a rough nail surface.
words.exampleTranslation: 甲银屑病会让指甲表面出现小凹点、变粗糙。

evidence.quote: Nail surface pitting, roughness, onycholysis, and bed discolorations
Psoriasis can also affect the nail plates, causing them to develop surface pits

words.example: The epidermis is the outer, thinnest skin layer, with no blood vessels.
words.exampleTranslation: 表皮是皮肤最外面、最薄的一层，没有血管。

evidence.quote: The epidermis (ep-uh-DUR-mis) is the outermost and thinnest layer of the skin. It does not contain blood vessels

words.example: The dermis, or true skin, has blood vessels and nerves.
words.exampleTranslation: 真皮也叫“真正的皮肤”，里面有血管和神经。

evidence.quote: The dermis (DER-mis), or true skin, is the underlying or inner layer of the skin.
there are numerous blood vessels, lymph vessels, nerves, sweat glands, oil glands

words.example: Subcutaneous tissue is a fatty layer below the dermis.
words.exampleTranslation: 皮下组织是真皮下面的一层脂肪。

evidence.quote: The subcutaneous tissue (sub-kyoo-TAY-nee-us TISH-ew) is a fatty layer found below the dermis.

words.example: The stratum corneum is the top skin layer that we care for.
words.exampleTranslation: 角质层是我们护理的皮肤最上面一层。

evidence.quote: The outermost top layer of our epidermis is the stratum corneum.
is the layer that is cared for by the beauty practitioner

words.example: The stratum germinativum, or basal layer, makes new skin cells.
words.exampleTranslation: 生发层也叫基底层，会产生新的皮肤细胞。

evidence.quote: is also known as the basal layer (BAY-zal LAY-er) and is the deepest living layer of the epidermis. It produces new epidermal skin cells

words.example: Tinea pedis is athlete's foot, a fungal infection.
words.exampleTranslation: 足癣就是脚气（athlete's foot），是一种真菌感染。

evidence.quote: Athlete’s foot or ringworm of the feet. The cause is fungal; it thrives in dark, moist places.

words.example: Sudoriferous glands, or sweat glands, send sweat out through pores.
words.exampleTranslation: 汗腺（sweat glands）把汗液从毛孔排出。

evidence.quote: the sudoriferous glands (soo-duh-RIF-uh-rus GLANZ) or sweat glands (SWET GLANZ)
a tubelike duct that opens at the surface of the skin to form the sweat pore

words.example: Sebaceous glands make sebum, the oil that keeps skin soft.
words.exampleTranslation: 皮脂腺分泌皮脂，这种油让皮肤保持柔软。

evidence.quote: These glands secrete sebum, a fatty or oily secretion that lubricates the skin
This oil lubricates the skin, keeping it soft and pliable.

words.example: A macule is a flat spot of color, like a freckle.
words.exampleTranslation: 斑疹是平的色斑，比如雀斑。

evidence.quote: A spot or discoloration on the skin, such as a freckle. Macules are neither raised or sunken.

words.example: Bromhidrosis is bad-smelling sweat, often in armpits or on feet.
words.exampleTranslation: 臭汗症是气味难闻的汗，常见于腋下或脚部。

evidence.quote: A foul-smelling perspiration, usually noticeable in the armpits or on the feet.

words.example: Chloasma are dark, flat spots, wrongly called liver spots.
words.exampleTranslation: 黄褐斑是平的深色斑点，常被误称为“肝斑”。

evidence.quote: increased pigmentation on the skin or dark spots that are not elevated
Chloasma are incorrectly called liver spots, even though they have nothing to do with the liver.

words.example: Verruca is a wart; a virus causes it, so it can spread.
words.exampleTranslation: verruca（疣）就是瘊子，由病毒引起，所以可能传染。

evidence.quote: The technical term for wart; the hypertrophy (hi-per-TRO-fee) of the papillae and epidermis. It is caused by a virus and is infectious.

words.example: The humerus is the big bone from your shoulder to your elbow.
words.exampleTranslation: 肱骨是从肩膀到肘部的那根大骨头。

evidence.quote: The uppermost and largest bone of the arm, extending from the elbow to the shoulder.

words.example: The ulna is the forearm bone on the little-finger side.
words.exampleTranslation: 尺骨是前臂位于小指一侧的骨头。

evidence.quote: It is larger at the elbow than at the wrist and is located on the little finger side of the hand.

words.example: The radius is the forearm bone on the thumb side.
words.exampleTranslation: 桡骨是前臂位于拇指一侧的骨头。

evidence.quote: The shorter of the two bones of the forearm. It is largest at the wrist and located on the thumb side of the hand.

words.example: The carpus, or wrist, has eight small bones.
words.exampleTranslation: 腕骨（即手腕）由八块小骨头组成。

evidence.quote: The wrist: a flexible joint composed of a group of eight small, irregular bones held together by ligaments.

words.example: The metacarpus is the five bones in the palm of the hand.
words.exampleTranslation: 掌骨是手掌里的五块骨头。

evidence.quote: Bones of the palm of the hand; parts of the hand containing five bones between the carpus and phalanges.

words.example: Phalanges are the bones of the fingers and toes.
words.exampleTranslation: 指骨/趾骨是手指和脚趾的骨头。

evidence.quote: Phalanges (fuh-LAN-jeez). Bones of the fingers or toes, or digits.

words.example: Extensors are muscles that straighten the wrist, hand, and fingers.
words.exampleTranslation: 伸肌是把手腕、手和手指伸直的肌肉。

evidence.quote: Muscles that straighten the wrist, hand, and fingers to form a straight line.

words.example: The tibia is the larger of the two bones below the knee.
words.exampleTranslation: 胫骨是膝盖下面两根骨头中较大的那根。

evidence.quote: is the larger of the two bones that form the leg below the knee

words.example: The femur is the heavy, long bone above the knee.
words.exampleTranslation: 股骨是膝盖上面那根又重又长的骨头。

evidence.quote: The femur (FEE-mur) is a heavy, long bone that forms the leg above the knee.

words.example: Abductors are muscles that separate the fingers.
words.exampleTranslation: 外展肌是把手指分开的肌肉。

evidence.quote: Abductors (ab-DUK-turz). Muscles that separate the fingers.

words.example: Pronators turn the hand so the palm faces down.
words.exampleTranslation: 旋前肌让手转动，使掌心朝下。

evidence.quote: Muscles that turn the hand inward so that the palm faces downward.

words.example: The gastrocnemius attaches at the heel and pulls the foot down.
words.exampleTranslation: 腓肠肌附着在脚跟上，把脚往下拉。

evidence.quote: is attached to the lower rear surface of the heel and pulls the foot down

words.example: Melanin gives the skin its color.
words.exampleTranslation: 黑色素决定皮肤的颜色。

evidence.quote: The color of the skin—whether fair, medium, or dark—depends primarily on melanin

words.example: Flexors are muscles that help bend the wrist.
words.exampleTranslation: 屈肌是帮助弯曲手腕的肌肉。

evidence.quote: Extensor muscles of the wrist are involved in bending the wrist.

words.example: The five metatarsals are long, slender bones of the foot.
words.exampleTranslation: 五块跖骨是脚上细长的骨头。

evidence.quote: five metatarsal (meh-tah-TAHR-sul) bones, which are long and slender

words.example: The patella forms the cap of the knee.
words.exampleTranslation: 髌骨构成膝盖的盖子。

evidence.quote: The patella (pah-TEL-lah), also called the accessory bone, forms the cap of the knee joint

words.example: A vesicle is a small blister with clear fluid.
words.exampleTranslation: 水疱是装着清澈液体的小水泡。

evidence.quote: Small blister or sac containing clear fluid, lying within or just beneath the epidermis.

words.example: An ulcer is an open lesion on the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 溃疡是皮肤上的开放性皮损。

evidence.quote: An open lesion on the skin or mucous membrane of the body

words.example: Vitiligo causes milky-white spots on the skin.
words.exampleTranslation: 白癜风会让皮肤出现乳白色斑点。

evidence.quote: Milky-white spots (leukoderma) of the skin. Vitiligo is hereditary.

words.example: Malignant melanoma is the most serious form of skin cancer.
words.exampleTranslation: 恶性黑色素瘤是最严重的皮肤癌。

evidence.quote: The most serious form of skin cancer

meaning.en: dead, colorless tissue on the nail plate
meaning.zh: 粘在甲板上、无色的死组织

meaning.en: living skin at the nail base
skin between fingertip and free edge
meaning.zh: 指尖和游离缘之间的皮肤

tip.en: Hypo- = under: hyponychium is under the free edge. Ep- = over: eponychium, living skin over the base. Cuticle: dead.
tip.zh: hypo- = 下面：甲下皮在游离缘下面。ep- = 上面：甲上皮是盖在指甲根部的活皮肤。甲小皮是死皮。看中文：甲上皮的“上”在根部，甲下皮的“下”在指尖下面。

evidence.quote: The cuticle (KYOO-tih-kul) is the nonliving, colorless tissue attached to the nail plate
Living skin at the base of the nail plate and covering the matrix area.
is the slightly thickened layer of skin that lies between the fingertip and the free edge of the nail plate

meaning.en: nail plate separates from the nail bed
fungal infection of the nail plate

tip.en: All start with onycho- (nail). Then: lysis = loosening, myco = fungus, crypto = hidden (the edge hides in skin).
tip.zh: 开头 onycho- 都是“指甲”。再看后面：lysis = 松开，myco = 真菌，crypto = 藏起来（指甲边藏进肉里）。

evidence.quote: Separation of the nail plate and bed, often due to injury or allergic reactions.
Fungal infection of the nail plate.
Ingrown nails on either hands or feet, wherein the nail grows into the sides of the tissue around the nail.

meaning.en: outer, thinnest layer with no blood vessels
meaning.zh: 最外面、最薄、没有血管的一层

meaning.en: the true skin, with blood vessels
fatty layer below the true skin

tip.en: Epi- = on top. Sub- = under, like subway. The dermis, the true skin, is in the middle.
tip.zh: epi- = 上面，sub- = 下面（像 subway 地铁在地下），真皮（dermis）在中间。看中文：表皮在表面，皮下组织在皮的下面。

evidence.quote: The epidermis (ep-uh-DUR-mis) is the outermost and thinnest layer of the skin. It does not contain blood vessels
The dermis (DER-mis), or true skin, is the underlying or inner layer of the skin.
there are numerous blood vessels, lymph vessels, nerves, sweat glands, oil glands
The subcutaneous tissue (sub-kyoo-TAY-nee-us TISH-ew) is a fatty layer found below the dermis.

meaning.en: glands that make oil for the skin
meaning.zh: 为皮肤分泌油脂的腺体

tip.en: Sebaceous glands make sebum (oil): both start with s-e-b. The other one, sudoriferous, makes sweat.
tip.zh: sebaceous 和 sebum（皮脂）都以 s-e-b 开头：皮脂腺出油。另一个 sudoriferous 是汗腺，出汗。

evidence.quote: The sudoriferous, or sweat, glands, which excrete sweat from the skin
These glands secrete sebum, a fatty or oily secretion that lubricates the skin

meaning.en: forearm bone on the little-finger side
forearm bone on the thumb side

tip.en: Feel the hard point of your elbow: that's the ulna, on the little-finger side. Radius: thumb side.
tip.zh: 摸一摸肘部尖尖的那块硬骨：那是尺骨（ulna），在小指一侧。桡骨（radius）在拇指一侧。

evidence.quote: It is larger at the elbow than at the wrist and is located on the little finger side of the hand.
It is largest at the wrist and located on the thumb side of the hand.

meaning.en: muscles that draw the fingers together

tip.en: Add = put together: adductors pull your fingers together. Abductors take them away from each other.
tip.zh: add（加）= 放到一起：adductors（内收肌）把手指并拢；abductors（外展肌）把手指分开。看中文：收 = 并拢，展 = 张开。

evidence.quote: Abductors (ab-DUK-turz). Muscles that separate the fingers.
Muscles at the base of each finger that draw the fingers together.
